title: Ringee — Calling Infrastructure for Humans & AI Agents
excerpt: Open calling infrastructure where human teams and AI voice agents place real calls from the same stack. Open source, self-hostable, and pay as you go.
content_html:
HumanMachine

Open source calling infrastructure

One calling stack. Humans and AI voice agents.

Turn more calls into customers. Your team focuses on the conversations that need a human touch, while AI voice agents handle follow-ups, reminders, and bookings — all in one place.

Runs from

+ any MCP client, or the CLI

Unlimited users. One $20/month team plan.

Free individual account. Calling usage billed separately.

  • Pay-as-you-go calling
  • Open source & self-hostable
  • No per-user fees

Trusted by teams already calling with Ringee

AI Voice Agents

When AI should take the call, it can.

Build an agent with its own voice, instructions, company context, and knowledge. It places the outbound call, holds the live conversation, uses tools, and returns the recording, transcript, summary, outcome, and structured data to Ringee.

Explore AI Voice AgentsSee AI automation

Book appointments

Check real calendar availability during the conversation and book only a time the person confirms.

Confirm and remind

Deliver reminders or updates, hear the response, schedule a callback, and bring a human in for follow-up when needed.

Not a separate stack

Human and AI calls use Ringee numbers, credits, call history, recordings, transcripts, outcomes, and integration events. Choose the right operator for each conversation.

The new era of dialing

Every screen is a dialer. Every user is included.

Web, phone, and the tab you are already in — one account, with pay-as-you-go calling from $0.012/min.

Unlimited users. One $20/month team plan.

Grow your team, not your bill

Unlimited users. One $20/month team plan. Add people without increasing your subscription. Calling usage is billed separately.

The most economical way to scale
